simple.meaning: כּוֹכָב (kôwkâb) appears 37 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, and 13 more, beginning at Genesis 1:16. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כּוֹכָב (H3556) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows כּוֹכָב through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: כּוֹכָב (kôwkâb) / H3556 is tracked through Genesis 1:16, Genesis 15:5, Genesis 22:17, Genesis 26:4. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince
definitions.full: H3556. kokab כּוֺכָב noun masculine Gen 15:5 star (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic כּוֺכַבְתָּא כּוֺכְבָא, , , feminine form specifically of planet Venus, see also We Skizzen iii. 36, 38 ; Arabic Generally of single stars and probably Aramaic loan-word, We Skizzen iii. 173 ; Ethiopic ; probably for * כבכב see Mahri kubkob, kobkib , etc., Maltzan ZMG 1873, 227 and Assyrian kakkabu Dl HWB 336 ; Punic κακαβουμ (Dioscorides), name of a plant, probably from shape of seed-cup, Blau ZMG xxvii, 1873, 529 ; on formation compare Nö M § 109 Ba NB § 138. 1 ) — ׳כ absolute Num 24:17 ; construct כּוֺכַב Amos 5:26 ; plural כּוֺכָבִים Gen 1:16 19 t.; construct כּוֺכְבֵי ( כֹּכְבֵי ) 22:17 13 t.; כֹּכְבֵיהֶם Ezek 32:7 ; — singular only ׳כ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם Amos 5:26 (where, however, ׳כ is probably a gloss, so GFM Dec. 19, 1890, and now We; see further כִּיּוּן ); and ׳כ מִיַּעֲקֹב Num 24:12 (J E; || בישׂראל שֵׁבֶט , metaphor of future ruler); elsewhere plural stars , || sun and moon (compare also below) Gen 1:16 (P) Psa 136:9 (to rule the night, compare Gen 1:16 ), Jer 31:35 ; Gen 37:9 (E), Joseph's dream ( כ עָשָׂר ׳אַחַד = 11 brethren); Deut 4:19 object of idolatrous worship (compare below); observed in augury בַּכּ ׳הַחֹזִים Isa 47:13 (of Babylon); Eccl 12:2 (|| (also) light ; figurative of brightness of youth); || sun Job 9:7 ; || moon Psa 8:4 ; sign of evening Neh 4:15 ( הַכּ צֵאת עַד הַשַּׁחַר ׳מֵעֲלוֺת ) compare נִשְׁכּוֺ כּוֺכְבֵי Job 3:9 (apparently sign of dawn); numbered by God Psa 147:4 ; simile of abundant posterity, Gen 15:5 ; 22:17 ; 26:4 ; Exod 32:13 (all J E); of Israel Deut 1:10 ; 10:22 ; 28:62 ; 1Chr 27:32 ; Neh 9:23 ; of number of merchants of Nineveh Nahum 3:16 ; as lofty, Job 22:12 ; so in figure of haughty nations Obadiah 4; Isa 14:13 ; compare symbolic vision of Daniel (|| הַשָּׁמַיִם צְבָא צָבָא, ) Dan 8:10 ; simile of brightness of righteous 12:3 ; not pure ( זַכּוּ ) before God Job 25:5 (|| moon); darkened in Yahweh's judgment Joel 2:10 ; Joel 4:15; Ezek 32:7 (|| sun and moon; so) Isa 13:10 (|| also כְּסִילֵיהֶם ); personified: as fighting Judg 5:20 ; shouting Job 38:7 ( בֹקֶר כּוֺכְבֵי בְּרָןיַֿחַד , || אֱלֹחִים בְּנֵי ); praising Psa 148:3 ( אוֺר כּוֺכְבֵי , || sun and moon). — On stars in Arabic mythology see We Skizzen iii. 173 f .
